versions.content: The service SoAd_WriteDhcpHostNameOption() shall forward the call to TcpIp_DhcpV6WriteOption() with the parameter Option set to the option code 39 according to IETF RFC 4704, if the socket connection identified by SoConId is related to a local address of the TcpIp_DomainType TCPIP_AF_INET6 .

The service SoAd_WriteDhcpHostNameOption() shall forward the call to TcpIp_DhcpV6WriteOption() with the parameter Option set to the option code 39 according to IETF RFC 4704, if the socket connection identified by SoConI d is related to a local address of the TcpIp_DomainType TCPIP_AF_INET6 .

The service SoAd_WriteDhcpHostNameOption () shall for- ward the call to TcpIp_DhcpV6WriteOption () with the parameter Option set to the option code 39 according to IETF RFC 4704 [10], if the socket connection identified by SoConId is related to a local address of the TcpIp_DomainType TCPIP_AF_INET6.
